description: This file defines an interface named 'Pipeline' within the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders'. It specifies methods for executing and validating a processing pipeline involving placeholders and expressions, likely part of a larger framework for processing placeholder-based models.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: An interface representing a processing pipeline capable of executing its stages with a given input and validating its configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pipeline stages starting with a given input and using an expression resolver to handle placeholder evaluation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether all stage expressions in the pipeline are supported, throwing an exception if unsupported functions are found.
